create_conditional_detr_object_detection: create a ConditionalDetrForObjectDetection model for COCO-style object detection with bounding box and class prediction
create_conditional_detr_segmentation_mod: create a ConditionalDetrForSegmentation model for panoptic and instance segmentation with mask prediction heads
create_conditional_detr_base_model: create a bare ConditionalDetrModel encoder-decoder transformer with backbone feature extraction and query embeddings
run_conditional_detr_object_detection: run conditional detr object detection on an image and return predicted bounding boxes with class logits
run_conditional_detr_segmentation: run conditional detr segmentation on an image and return predicted masks with class logits and bounding boxes
